description: Inherited by every lightspeedwp repository the Mend Renovate app is installed on.
A repository's own renovate.json is applied on top of this file and can override it.

packageRules.description: Automerge minor, patch, pin and digest updates once all status checks pass.
Below 1.0.0 a minor or patch update can break, so hold it for review.
lightspeed-hosting-infra merges only through its own review gate, so Renovate never automerges there.
